findings.message: The release records WIT-001 through WIT-004 as valid/unchanged, but direct image inspection shows WIT-001 contains cos(x) * x, WIT-002/WIT-003 show a calculator keypad (with the same image digest), and WIT-004 shows calculator layouts rather than grapher screens. This conflicts with those valid witness statuses and with approved Verification generation 14, which says the witnesses are incorrect or unestablished and the required Playwright geometry test was not run. Reconcile the records and retain the required geometry result before treating these items as conformant.
